headline: ATX Bowers get win No. 1, leaving 24.7 points on the bench
dek: A 153.56-point week beat Lover Boys by 54 and moved ATX Bowers to 1-7, even though the TE slots left a lot behind.

sections.title: Your week
sections.md:
ATX Bowers beat Lover Boys **153.56 to 99.3**. That's your first win of the year, and the record is now 1-7. The trade deadline is Week 11, so there are three weeks left to make moves.

- **MVP:** Tony Pollard scored **28.7**. Our projection had him at 13.1.
- **Other big starters:** Drake Maye **22.46**, Jonah Coleman **20.4**, Rashee Rice **18.3**, and the TB D/ST **18.0**.
- **Dud:** Mason Taylor scored **4.9** at TE. Brenton Strange added just 7.5 in the other TE slot.

Your best possible lineup scored **178.26**, so you left **24.7** on the bench (86% efficiency). The three costly swaps:

- Dalton Kincaid (18.6) on the bench for Mason Taylor (4.9): **13.7 points**.
- DeMario Douglas (16.6) on the bench for Brenton Strange (7.5): **9.1 points**.
- Jordan Addison (11.6) on the bench for Denzel Boston (9.7): **1.9 points**.

It didn't matter this week, but the TE spots were where the points leaked.

sections.title: Could you have known?
sections.md:
**Kincaid over Taylor (13.7 points): our projection pointed the right way.** It had Kincaid at 10.12 and Taylor at 8.95. Kincaid's team implied total was 28.8 against 24.0 for Taylor's. The case for Taylor was recent form: 12.6 per game over his last three, against 5.4 for Kincaid. Kincaid was also limited in Wednesday practice with a chest injury, which is a fair reason to hesitate. He played 57% of snaps and scored 18.6. It was a close call that a slight edge in the projection got right.

**Douglas over Strange (9.1 points): variance.** Our projection preferred Strange, 11.73 to 9.35. Strange had the stronger profile:

- 81% of snaps over his last three games.
- A 24% target share.
- A 27.8-point implied total for JAX.

Douglas had a 19% target share and 15.8 per game over his last three, but his expected points this week were only 5.1. He scored 16.6. Nothing in the pre-game data pointed that way.

**Addison over Boston (1.9 points): too close to call.** The projections were 9.86 and 10.05, and the real gap was under two points.

sections.title: Top performers
sections.md:
**By position (PPR)**

- **QB:** Joe Burrow **39.5** (xFP 28.8), Kirk Cousins 28.2, Josh Allen 26.6.
- **RB:** Tyler Allgeier **36.1**, Bhayshul Tuten 29.9, Tony Pollard 28.7 (yours).
- **WR:** Tee Higgins **37.5**, Ja'Marr Chase 31.1, Adonai Mitchell 27.2.
- **TE:** Brock Bowers **28.2**, Harold Fannin Jr. 23.4, Trey McBride 20.2. Dalton Kincaid was fourth at 18.6.
- **K:** Tyler Bass **16.0**.
- **DEF:** PIT D/ST **21.0**, then JAX D/ST 20.0, then your TB D/ST at 18.0.

**Beat their expected points**

- Allgeier scored 36.1 on 16.8 xFP.
- Emmett Johnson scored 25.3 on 6.7 xFP.
- Tuten scored 29.9 on 13.3 xFP.
- Higgins scored 37.5 on 21.4 xFP.
- Your DeMario Douglas scored 16.6 on 5.1 xFP.

**Usage without points**

- Javonte Williams had 23.4 xFP and scored 6.7.
- Mike Washington Jr. had 20.1 xFP and scored 8.3.
- Josh Allen had 39.0 xFP and still scored 26.6.
- DK Metcalf had 13.2 xFP and scored 1.4.

sections.title: Injuries on the field
sections.md:
- **Tyler Allgeier (ARI, Moore Than A Bite):** Jeremiyah Love (Lover Boys) went down with another ankle injury, and Bam Knight (Sebas350) left with a concussion. Allgeier handled the whole workload: 11 carries for 147 yards and a touchdown, plus five catches for 44 yards and a touchdown, for 36.1 points on 59% of snaps. Love has a "new" right ankle injury, with an update due later this week. Knight must clear concussion protocol before the Seahawks game. Allgeier is the lead back for now.
- **Lamar Jackson (BAL, Lover Boys):** He made his return from an ankle injury but suffered a serious thumb injury after one offensive snap and scored 0.0. Tyler Huntley then left with a toe injury, and undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano took over at QB. Mark Andrews (Bucky Charms) caught three passes for 14 yards in that 36-10 loss.
- **Christian Watson (GB, Chentudo El Venudo):** He was taken to the hospital with a chest injury on Thursday night after a 53-yard catch, and he was questionable to return. The report called it precautionary, since he walked off under his own power. He had six catches in the first half and finished with 17.3. Matthew Golden (Just Win Baby, 86% of snaps) is next up.
- **Hunter Henry (NE, Chentudo El Venudo):** He was ruled out with a foot injury after three catches for 30 yards. Eli Raridon (unrostered, 92% of snaps) is the Patriots' top pass-catching tight end while Henry is out.
- **Drake London (ATL, Justiniscleann):** He was evaluated for a possible concussion early after an interception thrown his way, and he scored 1.8. Jahan Dotson (unrostered) is next up.
- **Amon-Ra St. Brown (DET, I Love it Ra):** He went to the locker room in the first quarter with a head/knee issue, then returned and scored 12.6.
- **Dalton Kincaid (BUF, yours):** He was limited Wednesday with a chest injury, played 57% of snaps, and scored 18.6. Dawson Knox (unrostered) is the backup.

sections.title: Around the league
sections.md:
- **Moore Than A Bite had the high score:** 187.08 in a win over Sebas350, now 5-3. Joe Burrow scored 42.48 for them. They also left 32.9 on the bench, including Tyler Allgeier's 36.1 behind Ollie Gordon II's 6.9.
- **Game of Throws scored 168.98** with a perfect 100% lineup efficiency. D'Andre Swift led with 27.9.
- **Just Win Baby is 7-1,** the best record in the league, after a 163.18 week led by Tee Higgins' 37.5.
- **Chentudo El Venudo is 6-2** despite losing 110.68 to 86.06 against Justiniscleann. Makai Lemon (11.7) sat on the bench while Carnell Tate scored 0.0.
- **The Dakstreet Boys left 48.8 on the bench,** the most in the league (66% efficiency). Adonai Mitchell scored 27.2 on the bench while Tre Tucker scored 0.0 in the lineup. They are 1-7, level with you at the bottom.
- **More benching regrets:**
  - Lover Boys: Patrick Mahomes (25.44) sat while Chris Godwin Jr. scored 0.0, in a 54-point loss to you.
  - Sebas350: Kirk Cousins (28.18) sat while Breece Hall scored 0.0.
  - I Love it Ra: Emmett Johnson (25.3) sat while Omarion Hampton scored 4.7.
  - Bucky Charms: Wan'Dale Robinson (15.7) sat while Emanuel Wilson scored 0.0. They are 2-6.
